catalog.angular.description.es: Configuracion de comandos Angular organizada por areas funcionales en un unico archivo.
catalog.angular.description.en: Angular command configuration organized by functional areas in a single file.

groups.groups.angularCoreWorkflow.description.e: Comandos base del CLI de Angular para inicializacion, configuracion y tareas globales.
Core Angular CLI commands for initialization, configuration, and global tasks.

commands.commands.ngVersion.description.es: Muestra la version instalada de Angular CLI, Angular, Node, package manager y dependencias relacionadas del workspace actual.
commands.commands.ngVersion.description.en: Displays the installed version of Angular CLI, Angular, Node, package manager, and related dependencies in the current workspace.

commands.commands.ngHelp.description.es: Muestra la ayuda general de Angular CLI con los comandos disponibles.
commands.commands.ngHelp.description.en: Displays the general Angular CLI help with the available commands.

commands.commands.ngHelpGenerate.description.es: Muestra la ayuda especifica del comando generate.
commands.commands.ngHelpGenerate.description.en: Displays specific help for the generate command.

commands.commands.ngNewMyApp.description.es: Crea un nuevo proyecto Angular llamado my-app con la estructura base inicial.
commands.commands.ngNewMyApp.description.en: Creates a new Angular project named my-app with the initial base structure.

commands.commands.ngNewMyAppRoutingScss.descripti: Crea un nuevo proyecto Angular con routing habilitado y SCSS como preprocesador de estilos.
Creates a new Angular project with routing enabled and SCSS as the style preprocessor.

commands.commands.ngNewWorkspaceNoApp.description: Crea un workspace Angular sin aplicacion inicial, util para monorepos o estructuras con multiples proyectos.
Creates an Angular workspace without an initial application, useful for monorepos or multi-project structures.

commands.commands.ngConfig.description.es: Consulta o modifica la configuracion definida en angular.json o en la configuracion global del CLI.
commands.commands.ngConfig.description.en: Reads or updates the configuration defined in angular.json or the global CLI configuration.

commands.commands.ngConfigPackageManagerNpm.label: ng config cli.packageManager npm
ng config cli.packageManager npm
commands.commands.ngConfigPackageManagerNpm.descr: Configura npm como package manager por defecto para Angular CLI.
Configures npm as the default package manager for Angular CLI.

groups.groups.angularDevelopment.description.es: Comandos para desarrollo diario, compilacion, pruebas y ciclo local de trabajo.
groups.groups.angularDevelopment.description.en: Commands for daily development, builds, testing, and local workflow.

subgroups.subgroups.angularRun.description.es: Comandos para ejecutar aplicaciones Angular en local.
subgroups.subgroups.angularRun.description.en: Commands to run Angular applications locally.

commands.commands.ngServe.description.es: Levanta el servidor de desarrollo local de Angular y recompila automaticamente ante cambios.
commands.commands.ngServe.description.en: Starts the local Angular development server and rebuilds automatically on changes.

commands.commands.ngServeOpen.description.es: Levanta el servidor de desarrollo y abre automaticamente la aplicacion en el navegador.
commands.commands.ngServeOpen.description.en: Starts the development server and automatically opens the application in the browser.

commands.commands.ngServePort4300.description.es: Levanta la aplicacion Angular en el puerto 4300.
commands.commands.ngServePort4300.description.en: Starts the Angular application on port 4300.

Ejecuta la aplicacion usando la configuracion development definida en el workspace.
Runs the application using the development configuration defined in the workspace.

subgroups.subgroups.angularBuild.description.es: Comandos para compilar aplicaciones y librerias Angular.
subgroups.subgroups.angularBuild.description.en: Commands to build Angular applications and libraries.

commands.commands.ngBuild.description.es: Compila la aplicacion Angular y genera los artefactos de salida en la carpeta dist.
commands.commands.ngBuild.description.en: Builds the Angular application and generates output artifacts in the dist folder.

commands.commands.ngBuildProduction.description.e: Compila la aplicacion utilizando la configuracion de produccion definida en el workspace.
Builds the application using the production configuration defined in the workspace.

commands.commands.ngBuildWatch.description.es: Compila el proyecto en modo observacion, recompilando automaticamente ante cambios.
commands.commands.ngBuildWatch.description.en: Builds the project in watch mode, rebuilding automatically on changes.

commands.commands.ngBuildMyApp.description.es: Compila un proyecto concreto llamado my-app dentro del workspace.
commands.commands.ngBuildMyApp.description.en: Builds a specific project named my-app inside the workspace.

subgroups.subgroups.angularTest.description.es: Comandos para pruebas unitarias, cobertura y pruebas end-to-end.
subgroups.subgroups.angularTest.description.en: Commands for unit tests, coverage, and end-to-end tests.

commands.commands.ngTest.description.es: Ejecuta los tests unitarios del proyecto Angular mediante el runner configurado.
commands.commands.ngTest.description.en: Runs the Angular project's unit tests using the configured runner.

commands.commands.ngTestWatchFalse.description.es: Ejecuta los tests unitarios una sola vez, util para integracion continua.
commands.commands.ngTestWatchFalse.description.en: Runs unit tests once, useful for continuous integration.

Ejecuta los tests unitarios generando informe de cobertura de codigo.
Runs unit tests and generates a code coverage report.

commands.commands.ngE2e.description.es: Lanza las pruebas end-to-end configuradas para validar flujos completos de la aplicacion.
commands.commands.ngE2e.description.en: Runs the configured end-to-end tests to validate complete application flows.

subgroups.subgroups.angularQualityI18n.description: Comandos para analisis de calidad e internacionalizacion.
Commands for quality analysis and internationalization.

commands.commands.ngLint.description.es: Analiza el codigo fuente del proyecto para detectar errores de estilo y reglas de calidad cuando el linting esta configurado.
commands.commands.ngLint.description.en: Analyzes the project source code to detect style issues and quality rule violations when linting is configured.

commands.commands.ngExtractI18n.description.es: Extrae los mensajes internacionalizables de la aplicacion para su traduccion.
commands.commands.ngExtractI18n.description.en: Extracts translatable messages from the application for localization.

commands.commands.ngExtractI18nOutputPath.descrip: Extrae los mensajes internacionalizables y guarda los archivos generados en src/locale.
Extracts translatable messages and stores the generated files in src/locale.

groups.groups.angularScaffolding.description.es: Generacion de componentes y artefactos para acelerar la creacion de codigo.
groups.groups.angularScaffolding.description.en: Generation of components and artifacts to speed up code creation.

commands.commands.ngGenerateComponentUsers.descri: Genera un nuevo componente Angular llamado users.
Generates a new Angular component named users.

Genera un componente usando la forma corta del comando generate.
Generates a component using the short form of the generate command.

commands.commands.ngGenerateServiceUser.descripti: Genera un servicio Angular en la ruta services/user.
Generates an Angular service in the services/user path.

commands.commands.ngGeneratePipeCapitalize.descri: Genera un pipe Angular llamado capitalize en la ruta pipes.
Generates an Angular pipe named capitalize in the pipes path.

commands.commands.ngGenerateDirectiveHighlight.de: Genera una directiva Angular llamada highlight en la ruta directives.
Generates an Angular directive named highlight in the directives path.

commands.commands.ngGenerateGuardAuth.description: Genera un guard de Angular llamado auth para proteger rutas o flujos de navegacion.
Generates an Angular guard named auth to protect routes or navigation flows.

commands.commands.ngGenerateInterfaceUser.descrip: Genera una interfaz TypeScript para modelar datos de usuario.
Generates a TypeScript interface to model user data.

commands.commands.ngGenerateEnumUserRole.descript: Genera un enum TypeScript para representar roles de usuario.
Generates a TypeScript enum to represent user roles.

commands.commands.ngGenerateModuleAdmin.descripti: Genera un modulo Angular dentro de la ruta features/admin.
Generates an Angular module inside the features/admin path.

commands.commands.ngGenerateModuleAdminRouting.de: Genera un modulo Angular llamado admin con soporte de routing.
Generates a new Angular module named admin with routing support.

commands.commands.ngGenerateClassUser.description: Genera una clase TypeScript para representar o encapsular logica de usuario.
Generates a TypeScript class to represent or encapsulate user logic.

commands.commands.ngGenerateLibraryMyLib.descript: Genera una libreria Angular llamada my-lib dentro del workspace.
Generates an Angular library named my-lib inside the workspace.

groups.groups.angularWorkspaceManagement.descri: Herramientas para dependencias, actualizaciones, cache y gestion de espacios de trabajo.
Tools for dependencies, updates, cache, and workspace management.

subgroups.subgroups.angularDependencies.descriptio: Instalacion y mantenimiento de dependencias usadas por proyectos Angular.
Installation and maintenance of dependencies used by Angular projects.

commands.commands.ngAddAngularMaterial.descriptio: Instala Angular Material y aplica la configuracion inicial recomendada en el proyecto.
Installs Angular Material and applies the recommended initial project setup.

commands.commands.ngAddAngularPwa.description.es: Agrega soporte PWA al proyecto Angular mediante los schematics oficiales.
commands.commands.ngAddAngularPwa.description.en: Adds PWA support to the Angular project using official schematics.

commands.commands.ngAddNgrxStore.description.es: Agrega NgRx Store al proyecto para gestion centralizada del estado.
commands.commands.ngAddNgrxStore.description.en: Adds NgRx Store to the project for centralized state management.

commands.commands.ngAddAngularEslintSchematics.de: Agrega Angular ESLint al proyecto para configurar reglas de linting.
Adds Angular ESLint to the project to configure linting rules.

subgroups.subgroups.angularUpdates.description.es: Comandos para revisar y aplicar actualizaciones de Angular y dependencias relacionadas.
subgroups.subgroups.angularUpdates.description.en: Commands to review and apply updates for Angular and related dependencies.

commands.commands.ngUpdate.description.es: Muestra las actualizaciones disponibles para Angular y paquetes relacionados del workspace.
commands.commands.ngUpdate.description.en: Displays available updates for Angular and related workspace packages.

commands.commands.ngUpdateAngularCoreCli.descript: Actualiza Angular Core y Angular CLI a versiones compatibles dentro del workspace.
Updates Angular Core and Angular CLI to compatible versions within the workspace.

commands.commands.ngUpdateAngularMaterial.descrip: Actualiza Angular Material aplicando migraciones compatibles cuando esten disponibles.
Updates Angular Material and applies compatible migrations when available.

subgroups.subgroups.angularCache.description.es: Comandos para consultar y administrar la cache local de Angular CLI.
subgroups.subgroups.angularCache.description.en: Commands to inspect and manage the local Angular CLI cache.

commands.commands.ngCacheInfo.description.es: Muestra informacion sobre la cache local utilizada por Angular CLI.
commands.commands.ngCacheInfo.description.en: Displays information about the local cache used by Angular CLI.

commands.commands.ngCacheClean.description.es: Limpia la cache local utilizada por Angular CLI para compilaciones y tareas internas.
commands.commands.ngCacheClean.description.en: Clears the local cache used by Angular CLI for builds and internal tasks.

commands.commands.ngCacheEnable.description.es: Activa la cache local de Angular CLI.
commands.commands.ngCacheEnable.description.en: Enables the local Angular CLI cache.

commands.commands.ngCacheDisable.description.es: Desactiva la cache local de Angular CLI.
commands.commands.ngCacheDisable.description.en: Disables the local Angular CLI cache.
